label: PF Backlog 351
title: API-5 deferred hardening: rate limiting + request/upload limits + tenant-isolation expansion + event streaming
body: Deferred from API-5 (plan section 18 Security/Event API). Add rate limiting, request/upload size limits, tenant-isolation expansion, and event streaming (SSE/WebSocket/AG-UI) on the read-only Event API. Existing controls (authn/authz, redaction, idempotency, CORS, path validation) are already verified.
